d:
The Warriors defeated the Clippers, 124-112, tonight in Golden State. Yaxel Lendeborg finished with a team-high 37 points, along with 6 assists and 6 three-pointers for the Warriors, while De'Anthony Melton tallied 21 points, 6 rebounds, and 6 three-pointers in the game. Rui Hachimura recorded 24 points, 7 rebounds, and 4 three-pointers. The Warriors improve their record to 4-3 with the win, while the Clippers fall to 1-5 for the season.
